# Golden Prompt Requirements

The generated Codex prompt must contain:

- P0 待核实候选
- p0_readiness
- outreach_ready
- contact_needed
- product_scope_needed
- supplier_role
- source_access_path
- product_scope_questions
- contact_questions
- radar 事实不能提升 evidence_level
- route 统计只能影响 route_feasibility
- D1 requires transaction evidence
